snippet.title: Puzzles, Plush, and Pokémon Await in Pokémon Friends! 💡
snippet.description:
The more you solve, the more you can create! Enjoy that “Eureka!” moment every day by solving daily puzzles, collecting yarn, and making your own plush. 🧶 Then decorate your plush rooms to show off your favorites!

Your next “Eureka!” is just a puzzle away! You can download Pokémon Friends via Nintendo eShop, Google Play, or the App Store today!

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
Official Site: https://www.pokemon.com
Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/pokemon
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pokemonofficial
